decision.observation: An official bulletin dated 1982.11.23 says to stamp passports, return documents, admit Arstotzkan citizens only, and deny foreigners. A circular fixture is visible above the closed booth window.
decision.hypothesis: Clicking the circular fixture may call the first entrant or open the checkpoint.
decision.memory: Visible entry rule: Arstotzkan citizens only; foreigners denied.
